thread:
deploy-bot: Starting staged prod rollout `release/3.2.1` (commit `a1b2c3d`). Regions: US -> EU -> APAC. Env: production. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary 2.5% -> 10% step. Smoke checks enabled. rollout_id=r-20260320-89
elaine: Copy. Can we pin model variant to `redwood/llama-3-q4f16` for enterprise tenants during the rollout? Avoid q4 regressions.
tom: noted. Canary routers configured. I'll watch latency dashboards. @maria can you run the payment smoke set?
maria: On it. Running eval suite (120 prompts). ETA ~5m.
ajay: Quick check — DB migration flag `feature:cache-prefix` still OFF for this deploy, right?
elaine: Correct, leave it off until stable.
deploy-bot: US canary progressed: traffic -> 10%. Health: 99.8% 200, p95 +12ms. No error spikes. Advancing to EU in ~3m.
tom: US logs look clean. :thumbsup:
maria: Smoke results: pass 118/120. Two minor formatting diffs on receipts, not blocking.
ajay: EU canary started.
deploy-bot: EU canary finished: 10% traffic. Health: 99.6% 200, p95 +45ms (noticeable). Flagging p95 for review.
tom: p95 bump is concerning. @elaine any ideas? Could be kernel selection on EU GPUs.
elaine: Hold APAC until we confirm EU p95 cause. Proposal: enable compat routing in EU to `variant:compat-v3.1` if p95 >40ms.
deploy-bot: APAC rollout paused by elaine. APAC remains 0%. EU: compat route enabled for 30m.
ajay: Tagging rollout snapshot `snap-1769008901`, setting `rollback-able=true`.
maria: Re-running smoke on EU with compat route now.
deploy-bot: EU compat smoke: pass 120/120. Latency back to baseline. Will attempt APAC in 15m.
tom: If APAC nodes use older kernel, compat route should be safe. @infra-bot confirm APAC kernel version.
infra-bot: APAC nodes report kernel `k-1.9.7` (older). Recommended kernel `k-1.10.2` for q-attn perf; upgrade estimate ~40m.
elaine: We can't wait 40m. Plan: for APAC, roll using compat routing to avoid kernel mismatch. Schedule kernel upgrade for next maintenance window.
ajay: Proceed to resume APAC with compat routing, canary 2.5%.
deploy-bot: APAC canary started at 2.5%. Health: 98.9% 200, p95 +120ms, error spike 0.8% (transient).
tom: Error spike looks like connection resets to redis cache. Paging oncall.
ops-oncall: On it. Repro shows connection resets from cache-proxy in apac-cluster-3. Rolling restart cache-proxy group now.
deploy-bot: APAC canary paused at 2.5% by ops-oncall due to error spike. Rollout status summary: US: done, EU: done (compat route), APAC: paused - investigating.
maria: Suggest rollback APAC to previous stable tag `release/3.1.9` for customers in APAC until infra is patched.
elaine: Agreed. Initiate region-scoped rollback for APAC only. Keep US/EU on 3.2.1 (EU with compat).
deploy-bot: Initiating region-scoped rollback: APAC -> `release/3.1.9` (commit `z9y8x7w`). Rolling canary down to 0% then deploying stable tag. ETA ~6m.
ops-oncall: Cache-proxy restart reduced errors to 0.2%, but rollback already in progress.
deploy-bot: APAC rollback complete. APAC now on `release/3.1.9`. Health: 99.95% 200, p95 within baseline. rollout_id r-20260320-89 closed for APAC exception.
elaine: Good. We'll schedule kernel upgrades and re-run the full staged rollout in the next change window. Notifying affected APAC tenants pinned to dedicated clusters.
tom: Note for release notes: APAC rolled back due to infra-caused p95; EU served via compat route. Include rollback window and affected tenants.
maria: I'll create a short postmortem and add the two formatting diffs found during smoke run.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Release finished for regions with exceptions. Details: https://deploy.redwood.com/r/1769008901
